sourceIdentity: The image basis is the normalized output of the actual complete original T96 graph. The full graph proves each G row lies in im(R), and its distinct-head degree sum716 proves it spans im(R). Every quotient and complete remainder is saved. G*Q+remainder=RHS is accumulated independently in all1034 components and all9 RHS. The RHS is the exact saved normal-form combination (s-2)*(r1-c1*beta2275-c2*beta2276). An all-zero remainder pays membership in the full F31[s] R image only. Its source coefficients and the original6188-row mod961 identity are separate stages.
